title: Daily Market Digest
subtitle: August 11, 2026: Market Recap and Key Drivers

items.headline: U.S. Equities Close Higher, Led by Technology and Energy
items.summary: U.S. stock markets ended Tuesday's session with gains across major indices, driven by a resilient technology sector and strong performance in energy stocks. Investor sentiment remained cautiously optimistic as new economic data continued to shape market expectations.

items.headline: Apollo Global Management Rises
items.summary: Shares of Apollo Global Management Inc. advanced following positive institutional investor sentiment, reflecting robust portfolio performance.

items.headline: Axon Enterprise Climbs
items.summary: Axon Enterprise Inc. saw significant gains, potentially driven by anticipation of new product developments or favorable government contract prospects.

items.headline: KKR & Co. Inc. Up
items.summary: Investment firm KKR & Co. Inc. experienced an uptick, likely fueled by positive analyst ratings and strong activity in its private equity and credit divisions.

items.headline: Purple Innovation Plunges
items.summary: Purple Innovation Inc. faced a steep decline amid market speculation of a disappointing earnings pre-announcement or a significant analyst downgrade.

items.headline: The Beachbody Company Falls
items.summary: Shares of The Beachbody Company Inc. dropped considerably, possibly due to concerns over subscriber growth trends or increased competitive pressures in the fitness market.

items.headline: OppFi Inc. Sees Significant Losses
items.summary: OppFi Inc. experienced a substantial percentage loss, potentially influenced by emerging regulatory concerns or a missed financial guidance update.

items.headline: Energy and Industrials Lead Sector Gains, Tech Mixed
items.summary: The Energy sector led today's market with a 1.26% gain, boosted by higher oil prices. Industrials also performed strongly, up 0.75%, supported by increased capital spending. Technology, while contributing to overall index gains, ended nearly flat with a -0.04% change for the sector, reflecting ongoing debates over valuations and AI spending. Meanwhile, Consumer Staples (-0.36%) and Health Care (-0.21%) lagged.

items.headline: U.S. Economy Loses 23,000 Jobs in July; Unemployment Dips to 4.1%
items.summary: New labor data released recently indicated the U.S. economy unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs in July, contrary to economists' modest growth predictions. This contributed to the unemployment rate ticking down to 4.1%.

items.headline: Q2 2026 GDP Growth Slows to 1.5%
items.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Economic Analysis reported that real gross domestic product (GDP) expanded at an annual rate of 1.5% in the second quarter of 2026, a slowdown from the 2.1% growth seen in the first quarter.

items.headline: Iran Conflict Continues to Influence Oil Markets, Economic Outlook
items.summary: The ongoing conflict involving Iran continues to exert influence on global oil prices and broader economic sentiment, with ongoing discussions around the Strait of Hormuz closely watched by markets.

items.headline: Earnings Season Continues: Rocket Lab Misses, Airbnb Beats Expectations
items.summary: The Q2 earnings season saw Rocket Lab ($RKLB) miss analyst expectations in its report yesterday, while Airbnb ($ABNB) had previously beaten estimates earlier in the month. Several other key companies are continuing to report earnings today, influencing individual stock movements.
